name: Shroud
description: Privacy obfuscation with deterministic fake values and deobfuscation — PII never reaches the LLM, tool calls still work

secretKey.description: HMAC secret for deterministic mapping. Auto-generated if empty.

persistentSalt.description: Fixed salt for cross-session consistency. Empty = random per session.

allowlist.description: Values to never obfuscate (supports * and ? wildcards)

canaryEnabled.description: Inject tracking tokens to detect data leakage

auditEnabled.description: Track obfuscation events with tamper-evident chain hashing

verboseLogging.description: Alias for auditEnabled — enable verbose audit lines

auditIncludeProofHashes.description: Include salted SHA-256 proof hashes in audit lines

auditHashTruncate.description: Truncate proof hashes to N hex chars

auditMaxFakesSample.description: Include up to N fake replacement values in audit log (0 = disabled)

detectorOverrides.description: Override built-in detector rules: disable or change confidence by rule name

customPatterns.description: User-defined regex patterns for custom PII detection

maxToolDepth.description: Max nested tool call depth before warning

redactionLevel.description: Output mode: full (fake values), masked (partial masking), stats (category placeholders)

dryRun.description: Detect entities but don't replace — useful for testing detection rules

maxStoreMappings.description: Max mapping store size; oldest entries evicted when exceeded. 0 = unlimited.

honeypotEnabled.description: Inject fake credentials as tripwires to detect data exfiltration

honeypotRate.description: Honeypot injection rate (0.0-1.0). Higher = more frequent injection.

canarySystem.description: Inject canary tokens into system prompts to detect prompt extraction

injectionDetection.description: Injection detection mode: flag (log), block (reject), off

injectionScanResponses.description: Scan LLM responses for injection patterns

injectionMinSeverity.description: Minimum severity to report for injection events

profilingMode.description: Profiling mode: learning (baseline) or enforcing (alert on deviation)

transformerEnabled.description: Enable transformer-based tool sequence anomaly detection

transformerThreshold.description: Surprise score threshold to trigger anomaly event

signaturesUrl.description: URL for external injection signature JSON

siemWebhookUrl.description: Webhook URL for shipping security events

siemJsonlPath.description: JSONL file path for security event log
